checks.detail: A new private static helper with only identifier/linkage renamed, same explicit tstate and exc parameters, can preserve all three original C operations in order.

Existing do_raise first Py_INCREFs the handled exc; the original setter steals that new reference and XDECREFs the previous current_exception. No extra INCREF or DECREF is introduced, including when old_exc==exc or either is NULL.

Store the new raised exception before DECREF(old_exc), retaining the original finalizer-visible error state. Do not move DECREF before assignment or substitute a setter that obtains a different current thread state.

scope_limits: Only the specified helper and frozen unique call were reviewed.
